name: Humblewood Backgrounds (2024)
_note: 2024-style backgrounds: pick an ability-score spread among the three listed (either +2/+1 to two of them, or +1/+1/+1 to all three), gain the listed Origin feat (some offer a choice), two skill proficiencies, a tool proficiency, sometimes a language, and starting equipment. The background feature is included as a trait.

backgrounds.name: Bandit Defector
backgrounds.description: You were once a member of the Bandit Coalition, ambushing and robbing passing merchants, until you decided that life was no longer worth it and left — though quitting the Coalition isn't so easy.
backgrounds.tools: Disguise Kit, and one Gaming Set or Musical Instrument of your choice
backgrounds.equipment: a knife, a cooking pot, a winter blanket, an object you received as your cut from a successful robbery, common clothes, and a pouch with 10 gp

items.name: An object received as your cut from a robbery

feature.name: Bandit Routes
feature.description: You know the roads of the Wood and the escape paths bandits use. When not in combat, you (and companions you lead) can travel through forested areas twice as fast as your Speed would normally allow.

backgrounds.name: Grounded
backgrounds.description: Despite birdfolk culture's love of heights, you've always felt safest with your feet on the soil — practical and level-headed, and unusually able to connect with the humblefolk of the forest floor.
backgrounds.tools: one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice
backgrounds.equipment: a set of Artisan's Tools (one of your choice), a walking stick, a trinket from another culture, traveling clothes, and a belt pouch with 5 gp

feature.name: Find Another Path
feature.description: Having lived close to the ground, you always recall the general layout of terrain while traveling the forest floor. If your path is blocked by an obstacle that would require climbing or gaining height, you can always find a way around it, so long as one exists.

backgrounds.name: Wind-Touched
backgrounds.description: Legends tell of birdfolk blessed by the wind, destined to soar over any obstacle. Marked at birth or by surviving a dramatic childhood event, you've been branded 'Wind-Touched' — revered by some, doubted by others.
backgrounds.tools: one type of wind Musical Instrument
backgrounds.languages: Auran (you can speak as well as understand it)
backgrounds.equipment: a wind Musical Instrument of your choice, an ornate cloak, a symbol of the wind, common clothes, and a belt pouch with 10 gp

feature.name: Supernatural Presence
feature.description: Many across Everden believe you're divinely blessed. When you make a show of power or skill attributed to the wind or air (feats of acrobatics, commanding unseen forces), believers are bolstered by your presence and will support you — treating you with reverence, or even worship, depending on how well you've convinced them.
